question: Can the end of growth with closings anywhere be read from its prefix counts, better than from knots per distinction or degrees, and how close to its closing hazard?

definitions.growths: 800 X(0.3) to 6,000 moves; seeds sha256 PE:X0.3:run.
definitions.positives: each ending's last base at age M.
definitions.negatives: 3 risk-set growths of the same parity alive past M, read at M; 3 secondary with >= M + 500 knots.
definitions.features: mn, kappa, maxD, Uprefix (20 uniform resamples per prefix), Pnest (100 nested resamples), hazard (exact tie classes), logit (conditional, paired differences, even runs fit, odd runs test).
definitions.metric: matched concordance with growth-level bootstrap intervals.

public_inputs.code: census.py (sha256 d6b893377016a41787a6f4c58c78e0c0439bfd51c09152d7fd4c64e1c55c32ce) beside this file; fates.py (sha256 72d3571ed66dddaa6c517b3ce29ce14ae72c008c025669e2ef071b77b73eba35); pysat; numpy.
public_inputs.run: census.py --grow, then --features, then --summary, from the repository root; output artifacts/PREFIX-END-20261112-001A/PREFIX-END-20261112-001A-E001_prefix_end/.

forbidden_inputs: Changing growths, matching, features, resamples, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: Matched concordances of each feature, their paired differences, E1's shares.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Knots per distinction (E0) and degrees (kappa) as baselines; the hazard as a ceiling.

predictions.E1: < 10% of last bases have a prefix whose uniform resample ends > half the time
predictions.E2: Pnest >= 0.65 and >= mn + 0.05 with CI above 0; kill within 0.05
predictions.E4: logit beats the best cheap feature on odd runs, CI above 0

decision_rules.E2 holds: the prefix counts read the end beyond density

stop_rule: One run and its summary; a hand-off to the referee thread; report.
runtime: About forty minutes on eight workers; systemd-run --user -p MemoryMax=12G -p MemorySwapMax=0.
